bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to early learning; appropriating money to fund baby brain builder tool kits.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; BABY BRAIN BUILDER TOOL KITS.

$1,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of children, youth, and families for a grant to Minnesota Rally to Read to provide baby brain builder tool kits to families with newborn children.
